summary: The source has modeled frame geometry welded to its front-only leaf. Whole-face separation and a documented inferred rear/thickness make it usable; static, viewed previews and isolated RTX 4090 physics pass.
previous_finding: Attempt 000001 was incorrectly interpreted as an absent frame based on connectivity. Cross-sections show two jambs and a header outside the central relief contour; no replacement frame is needed. Original inspection and prior review remain in the preserved attempt/Git history.

component_review.2: Original 70 frame faces outside the existing contour; fixed.
component_review.4: 296 original leaf faces selected from source component 2, plus projected rear and edge closure; moving.
component_review.0_1_3: Original lever/plate components remain moving and collidable.

modifications: Split the existing welded frame/leaf at its visible boundary; preserve source faces, UVs and original download.
Close the front-only leaf with an explicitly inferred rear plane and boundary walls, retaining its decorative front.
Uniform scale 0.75, proper rotation to Z-up and floor-centered opening; infer left hinge opposite the original handle at the opening-face corner. No mirrored geometry.
Apply 0.4% moving-assembly fit for operating clearance; preserve handle colliders.
Use one conservative solid-leaf hull (fills decorative recesses) and separate frame-part hulls. The source has no separate latch; start closed and unlatched.
limits: Rear plane, physical leaf thickness and hinge placement are inferred simulation preparation choices, not recovered manufacturer geometry. Rear reuses the front texture; no rear handle is invented.
Robot/expert qualification and the 45-degree gate remain in 5.1; ready for preparation only.
